chordless.note: chordless p: every host edge between two distinct entries of p joins consecutive entries (seq_consecutive); the common core of the views.

induced_path.note: induced_path p: uniq, adjacency path and chordless, the empty sequence allowed (X3's shape).

nonempty_induced_path.note: nonempty_induced_path p: a nonempty induced path (X91's shape); equivalent to p != [::] /\ induced_path p.

induced_path_between.note: induced_path_between a b p: a nonempty induced path whose head is a and whose last entry is b (the X98 / X114 formula and the public Record's pattern-edge field); a singleton joins a to b exactly when both are it.

long_induced_path_between.note: long_induced_path_between a b p: induced_path_between with the X67 clause 3 <= size p; equivalent to induced_path_between a b p /\ 3 <= size p.

has_induced_path_of_order.note: has_induced_path_of_order t: some nonempty induced path has exactly t vertices; false at 0, true at 1 iff the graph has a vertex (X208's contract, index encoding bridged by chordless_nthP).
